It was known as the '''Betway Premiership''' for sponsorship reasons, and also commonly referred to as the [[Premier Soccer League|PSL]] after the governing body.{{Cite web |last=Ngidi |first=Njabulo |title=Betway bets on PSL with R900 million sponsorship: 'We don't chase away anybody,' says Khoza |url=https://www.news24.com/sport/soccer/psl/betway-bets-on-psl-with-r900-million-sponsorship-we-dont-chase-away-anybody-says-khoza-20240724 |access-date=2024-08-09 |website=Sport |language=en-US}} The [[Orlando Pirates F.C.|Orlando Pirates]] won their fifth league title and first since the [[2011–12 South African Premiership]] season thus ending [[Mamelodi Sundowns F.C.|Mamelodi Sundowns]] reign as league champions. The [[Mamelodi Sundowns F.C.|Mamelodi Sundowns]] were defending the title they have won for eight consecutive years, the streak starting in the [[2017–18 South African Premiership|2017–18 season]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.timeslive.co.za/sport/soccer/2025-05-14-sundowns-crowned-league-champions-for-eighth-successive-season/|title=Sundowns crowned league champions for eighth successive season|accessdate=18 September 2025}} The [[Kaizer Chiefs]] drew an average home attendance of 20,347, the highest in the league. ==Teams== === Team changes === {{increase}} '''Promoted from [[2024–25 National First Division]]''' * [[Durban City F.C.
